name: encoding-reflection-call-through-a-function-value
description: A call through a variable, a struct field, a map entry or a method value whose every value is a known function of the program hands its arguments to each such function's parameters as a direct call does, so a value one of them encodes keeps its fields, and a value only a function that stores it is handed reports a field it writes and nothing reads. A call through a function-typed parameter, or through a variable a function literal is assigned to, holds a function the analysis does not follow, so its empty-interface argument has left the analysis and keeps its fields.
